explain: Fix the responsible stage before introducing training. Missing evidence points to retrieval, while repeatedly misusing correct context may justify a model-behavior experiment.
steps: Record whether required evidence was retrieved and assembled. || Choose the first failed boundary as the next intervention.
name: locate-model-failure

explain: An adaptation experiment needs held-out comparisons and regression slices, not just a decreasing training loss. The candidate is rejected when rare-case performance falls below its requirement.
steps: Compare baseline and adapted outcomes on the same held-out slices. || Enforce the critical slice requirement before adopting the model.
name: adaptation-comparison

explain: Parameter precision estimates weight storage; runtime cache adds a separate workload-dependent cost. These simplified byte counts omit scales, activations, and implementation overhead.
steps: Calculate 16-bit and 4-bit weight bytes. || Add a hypothetical cache reservation separately rather than claiming weights alone determine capacity.
name: serving-memory

explain: Throughput and interactive latency can move in opposite directions. Filter by the product's latency target before choosing the highest-throughput configuration.
steps: Compare two measured workload-shaped fixtures. || Keep only configurations meeting the declared p95 budget.
name: serving-tradeoff

explain: Confidence calibration compares predicted confidence with observed correctness in bins. Selective answering additionally decides which cases to answer under a policy.
steps: Compare a confidence bin's nominal probability with its reviewed accuracy. || Calculate coverage under a proposed answer threshold separately.
name: calibration
model-release-manifest-compatibility
explain: A model release manifest cryptographically binds base model weights, tokenizer vocab hashes, LoRA adapter configuration, and serving assumptions to prevent silent token drift in production inference.
steps: Compute cryptographic digests for tokenizer vocabularies and base model revisions. || Verify that LoRA adapter configurations match the runtime vocabulary hash before loading weights. || Reject incompatible deployments and validate serving assumptions.
